content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states that the Agency concluded Complainant 'failed to prove' discrimination, but the ROI evidence and the reasoning linking it to that conclusion are not in the file."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Allegations are attributed to Complainant and one point cites 'ROI at 101' for RMO awareness of race, but facts such as the termination date and the job-abandonment rationale have no identified source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Dated events run from termination through the EEO filing on October 9, 2020 to the FAD on March 3, 2022, but several dates are unspecified and the September 18 termination date conflicts with the September 24 separation email and the September 19 events."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record names no individual who made the FAD determination, cites only the procedural provision 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b) rather than the criteria applied, and does not show whether management responses were considered."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"An independent reviewer could not assess whether the Agency's conclusion is supported without the ROI and other outside context, since the record is only a background summary with the outcome text removed."}},"remediation_note":"The record would need the underlying ROI evidence with source attribution, the reasoning connecting that evidence to the FAD conclusion, and the identity of the decision-maker and the standard applied. It would also need a reconciled timeline that resolves the termination date discrepancy and fills in the unspecified dates, along with documentation of management's responses to the allegations."}
